value.hook: When CI is green but JUnit fails, or retry logs and artifact counts disagree
value.title: Pin CI proof to the successful job artifact

sections.name: body
sections.value:
A green latest CI job can coexist with older failed `junit-linux` artifacts. In #173 round 2, a name-only download selected an older failure; the run retained three same-named artifacts. Do not choose by name or highest ID: take the artifact ID printed by the successful job's upload log, then download `gh api repos/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/artifacts/<id>/zip`. Match executed case names/counts and failures against that job. Artifact13600700967 matched all2,195 passing cases; the older failure did not.

`gh run view --job ... --log` also returned an incomplete Node22 log during #176. Direct `gh api repos/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/jobs/<job_id>/logs` recovered the successful20-case shared-build execution. Keep the stale and correct receipts as provenance, rather than silently replacing evidence. Never substitute local tests or node_modules symlinks for missing CI proof.
